
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /font  (/glyphs)                           │
  │  Font / Glyph Profile                       │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Pick the glyph profile (Nerd Font, Unicode, ASCII).

  Usage:
    /font
    /font <profile>

  Details:
    Selects which glyph set RadSim uses for icons and symbols.
    Pick ASCII if your terminal font shows broken characters.

  Examples:
    $ /font
    $ /glyphs

  Related: /theme  /animations
